project.name: levelith-2
project.description: AI-first development with intelligent tooling and test-driven architecture

agent_instructions.preferred_approach: Start with MANIFEST.md for broad context, then entry_points, follow imports, prioritize docstrings
special_notes: ⚠️  CRITICAL: Read MANIFEST.md FIRST for project context and goals
⚠️  CRITICAL: Read AI_AGENT_GOLDEN_RULES.md BEFORE making any changes
✓ MANIFEST.md is human-curated - provides 'why' and 'what' context code cannot

✓ Always update AI index after changes: python dev/aiagent_navigator.py index
✓ Test-first development is mandatory - no exceptions
✓ Security scanning is automated - avoid vulnerabilities
